text: Final categorization: REVIEW (Justification: The paper is a systematic review and meta-analysis of power densities across energy types in the U.S., including their spatial land-use implications. While it applies power density estimates to NREL future energy scenarios and discusses resulting land-use changes, its primary purpose is to synthesize existing literature on power densities—not to develop or evaluate LULC prediction models. It touches on future land-use projections derived from energy scenarios but does not itself perform LULC modeling, prediction, or simulation. Therefore, it qualifies as a REVIEW that touches on LULC future prediction.)
